assertions: Original TabStop and TabAlign declarations use real shared typed transport.
Initialized Sequence object address binding shares the original pointer cell without a new lifetime engine.

stackDivergence.rationale: Task156 is in progress. Actual TabStop long/enum/char/char and TabAlign five-value declarations plus generated enum sentinel now use existing shared CPPU static type/Any/Sequence owners. UTF16 chars are numeric units, generated default chars remain zero, native value copies and typed compound transport are independent. Sequence getAddress only erases the original C++ address-of an initialized Sequence object into its existing sole pointer cell; no new owner, allocation, counter algorithm or binary document representation is added. Full SvxTabStop/SvxTabStopItem, actual numeric-locale decimal resolution and Writer consumer migration remain pending within this same task. Read-only comparison found230same/55different decimal separators across285upstream locale resources versus current Intl, so unconditional Intl substitution is rejected. UI localization and ICU implementation are outside this work. Existing semantic statuses and deliberate I/O/recovery deviations remain unchanged; this partial type work does not certify pool/model/UI/ODS readiness.
